summary: For SSH project sync through a proxy on RPM AAP, install ansible-builder, build a custom execution environment from ee-supported-rhel8 that adds nc (microdnf install -y nc), register it as localhost/my-env:latest, back up with ./setup.sh -b and re-run the installer.
